name: OAN Messaging Settings

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: queue_sms() does nothing and the jobs are idle.

fields.label: OAN API Base URL
fields.description: Scheme and host only, e.g. https://oan-messaging.dev.example.invalid

fields.label: Caller Token
fields.description: Issued by the OAN operator for this caller. site_config oan_messaging_token overrides it.

fields.label: CA Bundle Path
fields.description: Optional PEM path for the OAN API certificate.

fields.label: Clear Message Text After (days)
fields.description: Finished rows keep only delivery metadata after this many days: the text is cleared and the recipient masked. site_config oan_messaging_content_retention_days overrides it.

fields.label: Frappe send_sms Hook (only for apps that register it)
fields.description: Used only when an app on this site registers send_sms = "oan_messaging_connector.sms_hook.send_sms" in its hooks.py. New features should call queue_sms instead.

fields.label: Hook Message Purpose
fields.description: otp for a site whose Frappe SMS are one-time codes (Auth). site_config oan_messaging_hook_purpose overrides it.

fields.label: Hook Message Expiry (minutes)
fields.description: OAN drops the SMS if it cannot be sent within this time. At most 30 for otp (set it to the code's lifetime), at most 10080 otherwise. site_config oan_messaging_hook_expiry_minutes overrides it.

description: Connection to the OAN Messaging Service for this site.
